relationships.subject: IL-1β
relationships.evidence_quote: In IL-1β degraded cartilage, the collagen rearrangement under cyclic loading is disrupted and associated with reduced tissue stiffness.

key_findings: Cyclic loading reversibly broadens 3D collagen fibril orientation and reduces fibril pre-strain in cartilage.
IL-1β degradation disrupts load-induced collagen rearrangement and reduces stiffness.
